entities.summary: John Collison is an Irish-American entrepreneur. He is the president of Stripe, which he co-founded in 2010 with his brother Patrick. Collison was the youngest self-made billionaire in 2016. As of 2025, according to Bloomberg Billionaires Index, his net worth is estimated at US$9.3 billion.
